payload.description: Work on code with an AI helper, follow your GitHub projects and edit files, all in one place. Code is for people who build software, or want an AI to help them do it. It has three tabs: Sessions, where you work on code with an AI helper; GitHub, where you follow your projects, issues and changes; and Code, an editor to read and edit files. You do not need it for everyday chat with your Agents. It is part of Leaf's core.
